wargear.name: Bile-stained banner
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A banner so thick with dried filth that the wind cannot lift it, carried by men who no longer notice the stink. Every model in the unit gains Feel No Pain (6+).

wargear.name: Choking cloud canisters
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Canisters of sour vapour cracked open as the squad closes. Every model in the unit gains Fear (1).

wargear.name: Bloated sarcophagus
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. The occupant has been dead for years and the machine has kept him going on rot. The model gains Feel No Pain (6+).

wargear.name: Blight-grenade bandolier
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Bandoliers of cracked, leaking canisters. Gives the unit Blightbomb Salvo.

wargear.name: Reeking censer
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A swinging censer trailing a thick, buzzing cloud. Gives the model Dirge of Flies.

wargear.name: Tolling bell
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cracked bell rung for every brother who falls. Gives the bearer Death Knell.

wargear.name: Scab-plate carapace
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Layers of crusted plate grown over the armour. Gives the model Scabbed Carapace.

wargear.name: Choking exhaust vents
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Engine vents that trail a cloud of corrosive spores. Gives the vehicle Choking Wake.

wargear.name: Rot-fed spirit core
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A machine spirit that has learned to rot slowly. Gives the vehicle Unquiet Spirit.

wargear.name: Rust-plough
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A corroded plough blade fitted to the prow. Gives the vehicle Rust-Plough.

modifiers.text: Stoic lords of the Legion: +1 LD, -1 I.

rules.name: Inexorable
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Unhurried Death). A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Cool for Morale Checks and Checks to avoid gaining Tactical Statuses.

rules.name: Walking Dead
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Walking Dead March). A unit with this rule gains Move Through Cover. In any turn in which it did not move it also gains Feel No Pain (5+).

rules.name: Miasma of Contagion
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Doctrine of Contagion). Enemy units that charge a unit with this rule, or are charged by it, subtract 1 from their Weapon Skill for the first round of that combat.

rules.name: Sworn Guard
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Reaper's Honour Guard). A unit with this rule gains Feel No Pain (5+) while it is within 6" of Mortarion or Calas Typhon.

rules.name: Blightbomb Salvo
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, in the Shooting phase, the unit may throw blight at an enemy unit within 8". Make one automatic hit with Poisoned (4+), AP -, Damage 1 for each model in the unit, to a maximum of 5.

rules.name: Dirge of Flies
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy units within 6" of this model cannot make Reaction Shooting Attacks against it or its unit.

rules.name: Death Knell
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Each time a friendly Death Guard unit within 6" of the bearer is destroyed, every enemy unit within 12" loses 1 Cool until the end of the turn.

rules.name: Scabbed Carapace
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Attacks with AP 4 or worse made against this model have their AP treated as -.

rules.name: Choking Wake
rules.text: Legacy house rule. After a vehicle with this rule moves, each enemy unit it moved within 3" of suffers one automatic hit with Poisoned (4+), AP -, Damage 1.

rules.name: Unquiet Spirit
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, when a vehicle with this rule would be Stunned or Shaken, it ignores that result.

rules.name: Rust-Plough
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A vehicle with this rule ignores Difficult Terrain. Units it Rams lose 1 Cool until the end of the turn.

rites.name: Unhurried Death
rites.flavor: The Legion has never run, and it has never needed to.
benefits: Every Death Guard Infantry unit gains Feel No Pain (6+) and Inexorable: +1 Cool on Morale Checks and Checks to avoid Tactical Statuses.
limitations: Every Death Guard Infantry unit loses 1 Move.
No Fast Attack units and no model with the Antigrav type.

modifiers.text: Unhurried Death: Feel No Pain (6+), Inexorable, -1 M.

rites.name: The Walking Dead March
rites.flavor: No tracks. No wings. Only the long walk, and the guns that come with it.
benefits: Grave Warden Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Walking Dead: Move Through Cover, and Feel No Pain (5+) in any turn they did not move.
limitations: At least one Grave Warden Terminator Squad is required.
No Transport or Heavy Transport units.
No unit may start the battle in Reserve: the whole army deploys on the table.

modifiers.text: The Walking Dead March: Line (1), Walking Dead.

require.note: Bring at least one Grave Warden Terminator Squad.

rites.name: Doctrine of Contagion
rites.flavor: A battle is won when the other side is too sick to hold the line.
benefits: Mortus Poisoner Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Fear (1).
They gain Miasma of Contagion: enemies that charge them, or that they charge, subtract 1 from Weapon Skill in the first round.
limitations: At least two Mortus Poisoner Squads are required.
No Apothecaries and no Primus Medicae.

modifiers.text: Doctrine of Contagion: Fear (1), Miasma of Contagion.

require.note: Bring at least two Mortus Poisoner Squads.

rites.name: The Reaper's Honour Guard
rites.flavor: Where the Primarch walks, the Deathshroud walk a pace behind, and nothing else is permitted near.
benefits: Deathshroud Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Sworn Guard: Feel No Pain (5+) while within 6" of Mortarion or Calas Typhon.
limitations: The army must be led by Mortarion or Calas Typhon.
At least two Deathshroud Squads are required.
No Recon units, and no Heavy Assault units other than Grave Warden squads.

modifiers.text: The Reaper's Honour Guard: Line (1), Sworn Guard.

require.note: Mortarion or Calas Typhon must lead the army.
Bring at least two Deathshroud Squads.

armyRules.name: Death's Slow Tread
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. They do not flinch, and they do not hurry. A unit with this rule ignores the effects of Pinning (X) and Suppressive (X). It may not Rush, and its Reaction Shooting suffers -1 to Hit.

armyRules.name: Withering Blight
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Their wounds fester in the flesh. A model that is wounded but not slain by an attack from a unit with this rule has its Toughness reduced by 1 until the end of that turn.

armyRules.name: Pestilential Aura
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A cloud of rot rolls from the captains of the Legion. At the start of each Assault phase, each enemy unit in base contact with a model with this rule suffers one automatic hit with Poisoned (4+), AP -, Damage 1. A unit joined by such a model cannot benefit from Medic (X).
